DGX_2016_p11__paragraph_3.ocr:
Our cost excellence program, Invigorate, includes structured plans to drive savings and improve performance across 
the end-to-end value chain.  We believe that many of these efforts also strengthen our foundation for growth.  For example, in 
2016 we commenced the rollout of our improved logistics management system, strengthening and enhancing the efficiency of 
our courier system, and enhanced the functionality of our physician portal, improving the customer experience and reducing 
cost.
